pr_title: Fix beatmap listing potentially showing duplicate beatmap cards
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/20170

Matches web behaviour, by enforcing only one card of the same beatmap to appear in listing. This required changes to the test scene since it was already populating duplicated beatmaps in some tests.
pr_comments:
Feels like a pretty dodgy solution. Like, sure, it'll work, but is it worth solving something like this in such a way rather than waiting for a correct fix with how ES is processing results?

The same issue is going to stem in API responses to users, and potentially other usages elsewhere in lazer in the future.
FWIW I asked nanaya about this and the actual fix may take some time, so merging this is a good move in the mean time.

issue_context.title: Beatmap listing rarely shows same song twice
issue_context.body:
Not sure on the cause of this one. Maybe our side, maybe osu-web. ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/20169
Originally posted by **Non-Binary-Programmer** September 7, 2022 ### Type Game behaviour ### Bug description Rarely, the beatmap listing will show two copies of the same song. Additionally, when you begin to download one the other also shows the download progress. This has only happened for me with the beatmap of [CORE](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/481511#osu/1271279), and it is inconsistent. ### Screenshots or videos (When hovered or clicked on, the beatmaps are exactly identical) ### Version 2022.902.1 ### Logs [database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9501118/database.log) [network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9501119/network.log) [performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9501120/performance.log) [runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9501121/runtime.log)
comments: The issue has returned (ver. 2022.1022.0-lazer); search term "Ryuusei Aika". [database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9885065/database.log) [input.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9885066/input.log) [network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9885067/network.log) [performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9885068/performance.log) [runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/9885069/runtime.log)
This is still open and tracked at osu-web (ppy/osu-web#9270) for what that's worth.
That's weird, if the beatmaps are equivalent and failed the LINQ explicit operation, then the game would've crashed the moment both of them are added to the listing...

review_comments: I'm okay with merging this in as the effort has already been spent on making this work / adding testing, but if it is to be done, this needs an inline comment mentioning this is a temporary hotfix, and linking to the osu-web issue thread.
I already attached one in the test case, but I guess I could add one here.
